mapper.update:
UPDATE dcws_common_approve
status=#{status},
user_Id=#{userId},
update_time = sysdate WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select * from (SELECT RES.task_Name,RES.status,RES.create_time,AHP.user_Id FROM dcws_common_approve RES INNER JOIN dcws_common_approve_user AHP ON RES.task_id = AHP.task_id ORDER BY RES.create_time DESC) t ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select * from (SELECT RES.task_Name,RES.status,RES.create_time,AHP.user_Id FROM dcws_common_approve RES INNER JOIN dcws_common_approve_his AHP ON RES.task_id = AHP.task_id where AHP.update_time is not null ORDER BY RES.create_time DESC) t ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
